# Acceptance Test Template

This template defines the skeleton of a generated Playwright `.spec.ts` file.
It is resolved by `speckit.trasgospec.acceptance-tests` via the template resolution stack.
Users can override it at `.specify/templates/overrides/acceptance-test-template.md`.

## Traceability Header

Every generated file MUST begin with this header block:

```typescript
/**
 * @generated by speckit.trasgospec.acceptance-tests
 * @spec {SPEC_PATH}
 * @story {STORY_ID} - {STORY_TITLE}
 * @generated-at {TIMESTAMP}
 *
 * DO NOT DELETE this header block. It identifies this file as agent-generated
 * and enables incremental updates when the spec changes.
 */
```

## File Structure

```typescript
import { test, expect } from '{FIXTURES_IMPORT}';

test.describe('{STORY_ID} - {STORY_TITLE}', () => {

  /**
   * Scenario {SCENARIO_NUMBER}:
   * Given {GIVEN_TEXT}
   * When {WHEN_TEXT}
   * Then {THEN_TEXT}
   */
  test('{STORY_ID}-S{SCENARIO_NUMBER}: {SCENARIO_DESCRIPTION}', async ({ {FIXTURES} }) => {
    await test.step('Given {GIVEN_TEXT}', async () => {
      // Arrange
    });

    await test.step('When {WHEN_TEXT}', async () => {
      // Act
    });

    await test.step('Then {THEN_TEXT}', async () => {
      // Assert
    });
  });

});
```

## Page Object Structure

```typescript
import { type Locator, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

export class {PAGE_NAME} {
  // Locators declared from contract parts or frontend analysis
  readonly {PART_NAME}: Locator;

  constructor(private readonly page: Page) {
    // Use accessibility-first selectors:
    // getByRole > getByLabel > getByText > getByTestId
    this.{PART_NAME} = page.getByRole('{ROLE}', { name: '{ACCESSIBLE_NAME}' });
  }

  async goto(): Promise<void> {
    await this.page.goto('{ROUTE_PATH}');
  }

  // Domain-level action methods (not generic wrappers)
  async {ACTION_NAME}(): Promise<void> {
    // User-level operation
  }
}
```

## Fixture Structure

```typescript
import { test as base, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import { {PAGE_NAME} } from './pages/{PAGE_FILE}';

type PageFixtures = {
  {FIXTURE_NAME}: {PAGE_NAME};
};

export const test = base.extend<PageFixtures>({
  {FIXTURE_NAME}: async ({ page }, use) => {
    await use(new {PAGE_NAME}(page));
  },
});

export { expect };
```

## Placeholder Reference

| Placeholder | Source | Description |
|-------------|--------|-------------|
| `{SPEC_PATH}` | `.specify/feature.json` | Repo-relative path to spec file |
| `{STORY_ID}` | Parsed from spec heading | `US{N}` format |
| `{STORY_TITLE}` | Parsed from spec heading | User story title text |
| `{TIMESTAMP}` | Generation time | ISO 8601 format |
| `{FIXTURES_IMPORT}` | Project context | Path to fixtures file |
| `{FIXTURES}` | Page objects used | Destructured fixture names |
| `{SCENARIO_NUMBER}` | Parsed list position | 1-based index within story |
| `{SCENARIO_DESCRIPTION}` | Derived from GWT | Short description |
| `{GIVEN_TEXT}` | Parsed from spec | Full Given clause |
| `{WHEN_TEXT}` | Parsed from spec | Full When clause |
| `{THEN_TEXT}` | Parsed from spec | Full Then clause |
| `{PAGE_NAME}` | Component/page name | PascalCase class name |
| `{PART_NAME}` | Contract or analysis | camelCase locator name |
| `{ROLE}` | Contract or ARIA | ARIA role string |
| `{ACCESSIBLE_NAME}` | Contract or label | Accessible name |
| `{ROUTE_PATH}` | Routing analysis | Navigation URL path |
| `{FIXTURE_NAME}` | Page object name | camelCase fixture key |
| `{PAGE_FILE}` | Page object file | kebab-case filename |
| `{ACTION_NAME}` | Contract or analysis | camelCase method name |

## Anti-Patterns (MUST NOT appear in generated output)

- `page.waitForTimeout(N)` — use web-first assertions instead
- `.class > div:nth-child(2)` — use semantic selectors
- `extends BasePage` — use composition via fixtures
- `.nth(N)` for business items — use filter by content
- `await locator.isVisible()` — use `await expect(locator).toBeVisible()`
- Shared mutable state between tests
